scope: Read-only accounting verification of five wave6 original-project CG series and five delivered atlases, with the newly refused Batman atlas request isolated.
independenceScope: Counts derived independently from distinct frozen native-file lists, actual SHA/PNG decoding, delivered-media SHA and actual source RGB comparisons; no totals copied from the global delivery report or the requested expected totals. This checker produced Brann and reviewed Lyra; this document is an accounting check, not a new independent visual fidelity approval for all five characters.

countingDefinitions.successfulNativeOutput: One distinct existing PNG native output path and SHA256, successfully decoded, cited in final selected-source or wholly-unselected draft records. A correction returning another native PNG counts once. Technical composites, crops, source-reference transcodes, re-encodings, nearest resize derivatives and WebP exports do not count as new native outputs.
countingDefinitions.whollyUnselectedDraft: A native output contributing no pose or CG to the final delivery. A large sheet that still contributes any whole pose is a selected contributor, even when some of its poses were rejected. Unused cells of a contributing native are not additional wholly-unselected native outputs.
countingDefinitions.deliveredCGIllustration: One final CG entry with one accepted native and three exported media files (source PNG, master WebP, thumbnail WebP). The three media files are one illustration, not three native outputs.
countingDefinitions.deliveredAtlasSheet: One final installed 1024x1024 RGBA PNG containing16wholeposeframes; the16poses are not16independent generated files.
countingDefinitions.strictNativeRgbSource: Native and delivered source PNG decode to exactly the same dimensions and sRGB RGB bytes, regardless of compressed PNG file SHA.
countingDefinitions.fullFrameNearestConditionedSource: Native dimensions differ from the required3:4 source; resizing the entire native RGB to delivered source dimensions with nearest neighbor reproduces every delivered RGB byte. No crop or semantic painting asserted.
countingDefinitions.newProviderRefusalsRecorded: Count of recorded refusal evidence in this wave only. Five-series zero counts are receipt/companion assertions, not a provider-wide independently queried log; Batman has one preserved moderation_blocked actual-tool-error record with no output.
